pattern: とみえる / とみえて
purpose: Infer an explanation from observable signs.
keywords: Plain form + とみえる / とみえて
He appeared tired, as he fell asleep immediately.
Apparently no one was there, as the house was quiet.
They appear to have lost their way. They keep walking around the same place.
formation: Plain form + とみえる / とみえて
restrictions: とみえて connects the inference to a visible result; usually concerns someone else or an external situation.
mistake: It is an inference, not a direct statement of the person’s private feelings.
